_about: One row per pre-registered test or research note. Read by the chorus-howl dashboard (Research tab). Numbers are out-of-sample unless noted. Update when a test finishes.

tests.name: 5m mean-reversion scalping
tests.note: Edge disappeared after realistic costs (3-5 bps per side) and one tail event (2025-10-10 crash).

tests.name: Funding carry (spot long + perp short)
tests.note: About +3% to +14% a year net, market-neutral. Needs perpetual futures, which Binance.US doesn't offer to US users.

tests.name: Breakout v1 (BTC/ETH/SOL)
tests.note: Drawdown 22.8% over the old 20% limit. ETH +43%, SOL +37%, BTC -8.5%.

tests.name: Breakout v2 (ETH/SOL, brake)
tests.note: Designed after v1's result, so only forward data counts. 3-week check around 2026-11-24.

tests.name: Alt-coin breakout (XRP/DOGE/LINK)
tests.note: Drawdown 26.5% over the old 20% limit. XRP +93%, DOGE +42%, LINK -31%.

tests.name: Breakout XRP/DOGE (brake)
tests.note: Coins picked after seeing results, so only forward data counts.

tests.name: Batch 1: daily trend, vol-scaled
tests.note: Strong 2022-24 (Sharpe 1.62), nearly flat in the 2025-26 bear market.

tests.name: Batch 1: trend + funding filter
tests.note: The funding filter made trend worse in every setting.

tests.name: Batch 1: vol-sized breakout
tests.note: Best result so far. Capped at watch because its signals were seen before.

tests.name: Breakout vol-sized (6 coins)
tests.note: Promotion to candidate needs 3 months and 15 entries of forward data.

tests.name: Batch 2: ML meta-labeled breakout
tests.note: Model no better than a coin flip (AUC 0.50); filtering removed the big winners.

tests.name: Batch 2: gradient-boosted daily model
tests.note: 52.7% accuracy (AUC 0.54), eaten by daily trading costs.

tests.name: Maker-first execution (live canary)
tests.note: 60 round trips of ~$12 alternating post-only and market orders. Adopt if maker-first saves >= 1 bps per side and 90% finish within 75 s. First attempt voided: two copies ran at once for 4 cycles; restarted fresh with a single-instance lock.

tests.name: Batch 3: trade order flow
tests.note: Best signal (1h flow z-score, 12h reversal) had test IC +0.002 vs -0.070 in selection; no pair significant. Order flow didn't predict 4-12h returns.
